techniques.label: parallel-b-standard-42-techniques
techniques.observations: All216 production-color frames actually inspected in six native paired sheets: nine equipped techniques, front/side, twelve times each. Lightning strike/pulse/breaker, fire pulse, open wound, expose, rally, protect and signature keep the head, snout, whiskers, ears, arms, feet and tail connected to the body through motion and recovery.

limits: Local exact-hash review, no live delivery or authenticated modal claim. Scarf naturally covers some throat surfaces; visible gray lower face/chin and incisors inspected in brighter production lighting, with no collapse or tear observed. One fresh216-frame companion technique capture using battle mesh, not source override or an independent second timing capture. Original component provenance is retained exactly.
